purpose: Transition continuity validation dimensions for generated video sequences.

cut_continuity.description: Hard cuts preserve spatial orientation, eyeline match, and action continuity across edit boundaries.

camera_transition.description: Camera moves, reframes, and coverage role changes remain intentional and narratively motivated.

scene_transition.description: Scene boundaries communicate location/time shifts without continuity breaks in identity anchors.

temporal_transition.description: Time jumps, flashbacks, and parallel cuts maintain timeline coherence with declared story position.
